answer: Problem: sybil fleets mint cold keys that wander across panels before bonds mature. Mechanism: lock 0.025 POA in a jetty escrow keyed by H(addr||epoch||salt), then keep a live kernel cadence of ≥5 peer attestations on 3 distinct parent tips inside 36h before grading weight unlocks. Cost: bond frozen 2 epochs plus three-tip stamps. Verification: peers match escrow unspent and tip ids on-ledger. Failure-handling: missed cadence or reused salt burns the bond and cools the address 1 epoch.
